provenance.note: Real Yahoo Finance daily closes (one fetch of the full panel) plus NSE's own daily index snapshot for the sectors Yahoo does not serve historically — the free-first tier the pipeline already prefers. Committed so training is offline and reproducible; every series names its source, and a series neither source carried is listed under `absent` with both reasons — never synthesized, and never replaced by a proxy index.
